title: Benowitz's APRO membership application
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Benowitz's APRO membership application, about late 1970s at Aerial Phenomena Research Organization, Arizona, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they said, "What's your favorite UFO book?" And he said, "Books by Heinick." That's all he said.

plain: Greg Bishop, a writer who looks into UFO history, says he saw the form Paul Bennewitz filled out in the late 1970s to join the Aerial Phenomena Research Organization, a civilian UFO research group based in Arizona. According to Bishop, when the form asked for his favorite UFO book, Bennewitz wrote only "Books by Hynek," meaning the UFO researcher J. Allen Hynek. Bishop tells it to show what kind of calm, ordinary UFO enthusiast Bennewitz was before the later events said to have broken his mind.
